title: A great habit tracker
body: This is really helped me stick to the goals that I set for this year. It’s not just the accountability, it’s also I like seeing the Percentages.Plus I like that you can sit variable goal so it doesn’t have to be that you’re trying to do something every single day.
author: taraisaducky

title: Great App
body: The user interface is extremely well designed being both sleek and simple. This app is the perfect tracker for anyone on the journey of self discipline.
author: Ceiegvs

title: Great and easy to use !
body: Keeps me on track and see my history
author: mjkhjkrdk

title: Great App
body: Keeps me motivated and on track
author: Karz;)

title: Only just begun
body: Just started using it and see value straight away. Well done team
author: peteshergold

title: Lost my account. Developer is not replying to my email
body: I purchased this app long time ago and when installed it back my premium account was gone. I then emailed them about this and they are not responding. It seems that I am not the only one as others are also experiencing the same. Take Caution when buying this app.
author: John484639

title: Useful. Stick to it!
body: If you're going to use this app, make using it a habit. You'll be so much more organised!
author: Plantsarekewl

title: Love it.
body: Great app. Helping hand in keeping me sober and meditating. Love pushing the date every night and hearing the ding. Ding you did not drink today, you rule !
author: Lairennnnnnn

title: Useful and beautiful
body: This app has really helped me get some bad habits under control (namely less bad eating and more exercise). It's a beautiful experience where there are configurable options, but it's not overwhelming. A great app :)
